case_id_use: Passthrough, type/presence validation only; no known-ID comparison or lookup table.
literal_decision_use: Interface enum constants and fail-closed record skeleton; no case-keyed expected-decision objects.
scorer_dependency: No import/call/runtime dependency. Source commit predates first scorer read. Scorer imported by qualification runner only after decisions persisted.
environment_or_path_answer_injection: No environment, path, dynamic import, dynamic execution, or file-access expression in frozen reducer.
order_dependency: Preregistered witness-order relation holds; arrays are normalized by sorting.
independence_achieved: Information aperture kept qualification controls/expectations/checker/history out of the implementation context until clean candidate freeze. Reducer has no runtime repository dependency. This is independence from qualification answers within the recorded aperture, not independent semantic assessment.
limits: Implementation and review performed by same qualification owner; no separate independent human review.
Authored public ledgers contain declared oracle-like semantic assessments; their natural-language validity is not established.
Finite controls plus source/runtime review do not prove correctness on every possible ledger.
The source-dependency review does not turn FALSIFIED control outcomes into a pass.
